purpose: Given BM25's top 10 legal units for a Legal MC item, does Qwen3.5-9B select the article that governs the question better than BM25's top 2 (filter), and does answering from its own selection beat the closed-book prompt on the pool (route)?

pool.description: the 134 Legal MC items of MC-101's pool (the MC-100 pool); not held out: MC-101's results motivated this test

reuse.mc101: data/diagnostic_legal_retrieval: its corpus, retrieval configuration and frozen K evidence, checked by hash
reuse.mc100: data/diagnostic_legal_oracle: its strata, support labels, oracle provisions and owner review, checked against what MC-100 registered

candidates.consistency: each record's first two units equal the item's MC-101 K evidence

selection.candidate_format: the campaign's evidence_item format joined by its evidence_separator
selection.question_block: the item's question and options exactly as the frozen B prompt carries them (diagnostic_retrieval.mc_query)
selection.parser: NFC, backticks and * stripped; the last line starting with 'Đoạn liên quan:' (case-insensitive); its integers 1..10 in the order written, duplicates dropped, at most two; with no such integer, a line containing 'không có' is an empty selection; anything else is unparsed
selection.fallback: an unparsed selection sends BM25's top 2 (the K evidence) to step 2 and counts as a miss for the filter question; an empty selection sends the frozen B prompt
selection.final: a completed step 1 is final even when unparsed; only technical failures are re-sent

arms.B: the item's frozen main-v1 MC prompt
arms.K: the campaign evidence block with MC-101's top-2 units, then the frozen prompt
arms.K10: the campaign evidence block with the 10 candidates, then the frozen prompt
arms.PICK: step 1 of SEL: the selection prompt
arms.SEL: step 2 of SEL: the campaign evidence block with the selected units, then the frozen prompt; the frozen prompt alone when the selection is empty; MC-101's top 2 when it is unparsed
arms.O: the campaign evidence block with MC-100's oracle provisions, then the frozen prompt; items with provisions only

rounds.rule: round 2 starts only when every round-1 attempt is complete; draw r of SEL uses draw r of PICK; the round-2 manifest is built from the round-1 rows, self-hashed, recorded and rebuilt on resume

analysis.item_score: the mean over the two draws: correctness for an answer arm, selection hit for PICK
analysis.selection_hit: the selection holds an oracle article: same document number (NFC, case, spaces, Đ/D folded) and article, any part counting; an empty or unparsed selection is a miss

questions.filter: on the 53 items with MC-100 oracle provisions: PICK's selection hit against BM25's top-2 hit
questions.route: on the 134 items: always-SEL against always-B

analysis.statistics: mean per-item difference; percentile bootstrap 95% interval (2,000 resamples, seed 7); two-sided sign-flip p-value (20,000 resamples, seed 7)
analysis.rule: a question is met when the left mean exceeds the right and its Holm-adjusted p-value is below alpha; route met means SEL should be the Legal MC route, otherwise always-B stays
analysis.descriptive: per MC-100 stratum on supports_gold items and on the items outside MC-100: B, K, K10, SEL and O with SEL-K, SEL-K10, K10-K and SEL-O, and in stratum wrong the share of O's gain kept by K, K10 and SEL; selection counts, positions, the share selecting exactly [1] and [2], precision, recall within reach and 'Không có' on items without an oracle article in the top 10; SEL's accuracy when its selection hits and misses; each arm's options on contradicts_gold items; the share answering A; mean tokens per arm (SEL with both steps); this run's B, K and O beside MC-101's
